rtpCapabilities.description: The RTP capabilities a WebRTC endpoint supports.

transportOptions.description: Parameters for creating one side of a WebRTC transport.

iceParameters.description: The opaque mediasoup ICE parameters blob.

iceCandidates.description: The mediasoup ICE candidates, one opaque blob per candidate. This is an array, not a single object, because that is what a WebRTC transport hands back.

dtlsParameters.description: The opaque mediasoup DTLS parameters blob.

direction.description: Which side of the call this transport carries.

iceServers.description: STUN and TURN servers the client should use while gathering candidates. Absent when the server has none configured.

producerInfo.description: A media producer available to consume.

paused.description: Whether the producer is currently paused.

rtpParameters.description: The opaque mediasoup RTP parameters blob.

speakingUpdate.description: A change in whether someone is currently speaking.

join.description: Joins a voice channel. A connection must join before sending any other frame, and joining a second channel leaves the first.

leave.description: Leaves the voice channel this connection is joined to.

getRtpCapabilities.description: Requests the router's RTP capabilities for the joined channel.

createTransport.description: Requests a new WebRTC transport for the joined channel.

direction.description: Whether this transport will send or receive media.

connectTransport.description: Completes DTLS negotiation for a transport this connection created.

dtlsParameters.description: The opaque mediasoup DTLS parameters blob.

produce.description: Starts producing media on a send transport this connection created.

transportId.description: The send transport to produce on.

rtpParameters.description: The opaque mediasoup RTP parameters blob.

closeProducer.description: Closes a producer this connection owns.

consume.description: Starts consuming another peer's producer on a receive transport this connection created.

transportId.description: The receive transport to consume on.

rtpCapabilities.description: This connection's opaque mediasoup RTP capabilities blob.

resumeConsumer.description: Resumes a consumer this connection created, which is created paused by default.

setConsumerPreference.description: Sets the highest simulcast or SVC layers a consumer this connection created should receive, and whether it should receive media at all. The server picks layers within the transport's bandwidth estimate and keeps a consumer paused while deafen silences it.

spatialLayer.description: The highest spatial layer to receive, where 0 is the lowest resolution.

temporalLayer.description: The highest temporal layer to receive. When absent, the server uses the highest one available.

paused.description: Whether the viewer wants this consumer paused, for example while its tile is off screen.

setSelfState.description: Updates this connection's own mute or deafen state. An absent field leaves the current value unchanged.

setSpeaking.description: Reports whether this connection's user is speaking, as detected on their device. Once a connection sends this, the server stops detecting speech from its audio level. The server reports false while the user is muted.

speaking.description: Whether the user is currently speaking.

heartbeat.description: Keeps the connection alive. The server answers with an ack.

error.description: Something the client sent could not be acted on.

joined.description: Confirms this connection has joined a voice channel.

region.description: The region of the node hosting the call.

peerJoined.description: Another peer joined the voice channel this connection is in.

peerLeft.description: A peer left the voice channel this connection is in.

codecUnsupported.description: A viewer in the voice channel can't decode the video codec of this client's screen share. The client can produce the screen share again with a more widely supported codec. Sent at most once per producer, only to the client that owns it.

producerId.description: The screen share producer a viewer couldn't consume.

disconnected.description: The server removed this client from the voice channel. Sent only to the client it applies to.

reason.description: Why it happened. 'nodeClosed' means the node hosting the call shut down before the call could move. 'migrated' means the call moved to another node and this connection is no longer needed.

moved.description: A moderator moved this client to another voice channel. The server has already removed it from the previous one. Sent only to the client it applies to.

moderationChanged.description: A peer's mute or deafen state changed, whether they did it themselves or a moderator did it to them.

muted.description: Whether the microphone is muted, for any reason.

deafened.description: Whether incoming audio is silenced, for any reason.

serverMuted.description: Whether a moderator muted them. When this is true the peer cannot unmute themselves.

serverDeafened.description: Whether a moderator deafened them. When this is true the peer cannot undeafen themselves.

migrationCandidate.description: A voice node a call can move to.

signalingUrl.description: Base URL for voice signaling on that node.

probeUrl.description: A cheap URL to measure the round trip to that node.

migrationProposal.description: This node is going offline and the call has to move. Clients measure the round trip to every candidate and answer with rttReport.

candidates.description: Voice nodes the call can move to.

deadline.description: When the call moves without further notice.

rttReport.description: Round trips this client measured to the candidates of a migrationProposal.

rttMs.description: Round trip in milliseconds. Absent when the node could not be reached.

migrateTo.description: The call moves to another node. Clients join the same channel there, switch their media over, and then leave this node.

nodeId.description: The node the call moves to.

signalingUrl.description: Base URL for voice signaling on that node.

now.description: True when a participant asked to move right away.

moveNow.description: Asks the node to move the call to the chosen node right away, without waiting for the deadline.

callElsewhere.description: The call in the requested channel runs on another node. Clients join it there.

signalingUrl.description: Base URL for voice signaling on that node.
